name: cursor-margins-clamp
about: With DECSTBM set to rows 2..4, CUU stops at the top margin and CUD stops at the bottom margin instead of at the screen edges. scripts/wterm-0.5.0-roost.patch, cursorUp/cursorDown.
patch: cursorUp clamps to scroll_top and cursorDown to scroll_bottom - 1
diverges_from_v2: The v2 patch clamps cursorUp/cursorDown to the DECSTBM margins. alacritty_terminal stops at the screen edges, ignoring the scroll region for relative motion.
